viewer.searchPlaceholder: Type and press Enter to search...
viewer.dataError: The condition could not be run. The previous result is still shown.
viewer.filterDropped: The condition could not be run. It was dropped, and the file is shown without it.

query.truncated: Showing the first {{max}} rows — add a LIMIT clause to narrow the result
query.placeholder: Write your SQL query here... (e.g., SELECT * FROM t)

result.partialProfile: Of the {{rows}} rows returned, not of everything the query matches.

chart.axisRule: First column: X. Remaining numeric columns: Y. Use SQL to aggregate, order, or align units.
chart.autoRule: Changing the SQL resets the chart type after a successful run.
chart.needColumns: Select an X column followed by at least one numeric column.
chart.unsupportedX: The first column cannot be charted. Use a supported SQL CAST.
chart.missingType: Result type information is unavailable. Run the query again.
chart.invalidResult: The result exceeds its row limit or has invalid limit information. Run the query again.
chart.duplicateColumns: Give every result column a unique name with AS.
chart.noValidPoints: No plottable values. Check NULLs, non-finite values, and precision.
chart.pointLimit: Plot limit: {{max}} points across all series; result: {{count}}. Reduce rows or numeric columns in SQL.
chart.unsafeRange: This numeric range cannot be plotted safely. Rescale it in SQL.
chart.partial: Based on the returned first {{n}} rows.
chart.continuousXRequired: Requires a numeric or date/time first column.
chart.switchedAutomatically: The previous chart type is unavailable; selected automatically.
chart.svgDescription: {{summary}} Read values in Data point details or switch to Table.
chart.detailKeys: Left/Right: point. Up/Down: series. Home/End: first/last. Escape: close tooltip.
chart.detailEmpty: No point selected. Focus here and use the arrow keys.
chart.orderHint: Connected in the order the rows were returned. Use ORDER BY to draw them in order.
chart.timePrecision: Finer than a millisecond, drawn at the millisecond: {{n}}
chart.pieCategory: Requires a text or boolean first column.
chart.pieOneSeries: Requires exactly one numeric column after the first.
chart.pieRows: Requires 1 to {{max}} rows. Group the rest in SQL.
chart.pieUnique: Requires a first column with no NULL and no repeated value. Use GROUP BY.
chart.pieValues: Requires a valid, non-negative value in every row, and at least one above zero.
chart.piePartial: Shares of a truncated result would not be shares of the data. Reduce the rows in SQL.
chart.approximateTotal: The total and the percentages are approximate.
chart.sliceKeys: Left/Right: slice. Home/End: first/last. Escape: close tooltip.

viewer.filterNeedsNumber: Column "{{column}}" is numeric; "{{value}}" is not a number.
viewer.filterNeedsBoolean: Column "{{column}}" is boolean; enter true or false.
